metadata.title: Groupicorn Hawai‘i IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. O‘ahu is subdivided into central, windward, and leeward catchments; Maui, Hawai‘i Island, Kaua‘i, and Moloka‘i are treated as separate island markets. Local provider groups are considered before explicitly named neighboring catchments. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings.
metadata.branding_note: Existing Hawai‘i PNG assets are referenced for eight providers. Other providers use live favicon proxies where an official website is known; brand assets are discovery references and have not been license-cleared for redistribution.
metadata.geocoding_note: ZIP codes and street addresses are stored when verified; coordinates intentionally left null in this pass. Geocode later with a chosen provider.
metadata.research_notes: The Jan. 5, 2026 Hawai‘i ADAD directory is the primary statewide source for contracted substance-use IOP/day-treatment locations. Provider pages and CARF/VA sources supplement it. Telehealth-only or city-only addresses remain explicitly flagged.

areas.name: Honolulu core / Kalihi / Hawai‘i Kai
areas.example_cities: Honolulu | Kalihi | Hawai‘i Kai | McCully | Sand Island
areas.geographic_rationale: Central O‘ahu catchment for Honolulu, Kalihi, and east-central outpatient programs; separated from windward and leeward corridors because island traffic and program clustering make them practical distinct searches.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.

areas.name: Windward O‘ahu / Kailua / Kaneohe / North Shore
areas.geographic_rationale: Windward and North Shore communities have a distinct provider corridor across the Ko‘olau range and should not be treated as Honolulu-local.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries

areas.name: Leeward O‘ahu / Waipahu / Ewa / Wai‘anae
areas.example_cities: Waipahu | Pearl City | Ewa Beach | Wai‘anae | Kapolei
areas.geographic_rationale: Leeward O‘ahu is a high-population corridor with separate treatment access patterns from central Honolulu and windward O‘ahu.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries

areas.name: Maui / Kahului / Wailuku / Upcountry
areas.geographic_rationale: Maui is treated as an island catchment; travel to other islands is not assumed to be a practical neighboring-area substitution.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries

areas.name: East Hawai‘i / Hilo / Kea‘au
areas.geographic_rationale: East Hawai‘i is separated from the Kona/South Kohala corridor because the island’s geography makes cross-island travel a material access issue.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.

areas.name: West Hawai‘i / Kona / Kealakekua / Holualoa
areas.example_cities: Kailua-Kona | Kealakekua | Holualoa | Keauhou | South Kona
areas.geographic_rationale: West Hawai‘i has its own Kona/South Kona treatment corridor and is not collapsed into Hilo.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.

areas.name: Kaua‘i / Līhu‘e
areas.geographic_rationale: Kaua‘i is an isolated island market; statewide telehealth is documented separately but is not represented as a local physical location.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.

areas.name: Moloka‘i / Kaunakakai
areas.geographic_rationale: Moloka‘i is retained as a separate rural island catchment so a single Maui list does not imply nearby access.
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
